description: Class representing a collection of format conditions.

Add.description: Adds a new format condition to the collection.

returns.description: The created format condition, or null if the operation failed.

Add.signature: Add(Type: XlFormatConditionType, Operator?: XlFormatConditionOperator, Formula1?: string | number | ApiRange, Formula2?: string | number | ApiRange): ApiFormatCondition | null

AddAboveAverage.description: Adds a new above average conditional formatting rule to the collection.

returns.description: The created above average rule, or null if the operation fails.

AddColorScale.description: Adds a new color scale conditional formatting rule to the collection.

params.description: The type of color scale (2 for two-color scale, 3 for three-color scale).
params.name: ColorScaleType

returns.description: The created color scale rule, or null if the operation fails.

AddDatabar.description: Adds a new data bar conditional formatting rule to the collection.

returns.description: The created data bar rule, or null if the operation fails.

AddIconSetCondition.description: Adds a new icon set conditional formatting rule to the collection.

returns.description: The created icon set rule, or null if the operation fails.

AddTop10.description: Adds a new top 10 conditional formatting rule to the collection.

returns.description: The created top 10 rule, or null if the operation fails.

AddUniqueValues.description: Adds a new unique values conditional formatting rule to the collection.

returns.description: The created unique values rule, or null if the operation fails.

Delete.description: Deletes all format conditions from the collection.

GetCount.description: Returns the number of conditional formatting rules in the collection.

returns.description: The number of conditional formatting rules in the collection.

GetItem.description: Returns a format condition by its index.

params.description: The index of the format condition (1-based).
params.name: index

GetParent.description: Returns the parent range object associated with the current conditional formatting collection.
